scope: Five concurrent short native sessions test original-case retention, model CLI/session isolation and structured transport only. No skill fidelity, general concurrency-limit, long-context performance or source savings claim.
launch_constraint: Launch only while source-measurement model phases are idle. Do not overlap the frozen serial Astra ledger cohort.
acceptance: All five original sessions must pass unchanged raw harness checks and exact fresh native audit replay. Any failure holds parallel-model readiness; no replacement.
Independently replay rendering grades and compare artifact text byte-for-byte with supplied literal, including punctuation/newline; cost must equal1.25.
Each sample must have exactly five MCP calls: two complete ordered policy reads, one write_output and one answer_rule in either order, then finish. No errors, extra calls or cross-directory access.
Bind all plan/frozen/source/runtime/harness/runner/worker/native hashes; actual model gpt-6.1-sol, effort medium, CLI0.169.0, successful exits.

Require five unique native session IDs and private client directories. Generated mailbox_id UUIDs must be globally unique across the phase. RPC IDs are scoped to each client/session and may repeat across sessions; bind each session/RPC pair and its exact mailbox/native/capture join.

Verify max(first native tool-call timestamps) < min(final tool-result or task-complete timestamps) across all five sessions, with full completion of all originals. This proves overlapping short-session windows, not concurrent provider execution, throughput or general service limits.
Read actual outputs and failures independently; preserve original serial pilot and failed development records.
closure_binding: All tracked JS/MJS/CJS/TS/JSON files under eval/ and plugin/, plus tracked package.json files and explicit runner/test/context inputs, frozen before launch. Covers current-worktree grader/contract/native/handoff dependencies separately from the pinned runtime manifest. No untracked dependency tree or live evidence data included.
